title: Vibrant Citrusy Dutch Smoked Salmon Salad
description: A refreshing and romantic Dutch dish featuring smoked salmon, citrus, and crunchy elements, perfect for a light lunch or dinner, and safe for those with nut allergies.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, orange segments, grapefruit segments, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil to make the dressing.
Season the dressing with salt and pepper to taste.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Arrange the smoked salmon slices on top of the salad.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh dill over the salmon.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a gentle toss to redistribute the ingredients.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional dill if desired.
